summary: Iteration 51 — Re-verified Fix #2 only (Payment Batch deep-link → filtered Shipments list) after main agent extended the `load` useCallback deps to `[search, paymentBatchPick?.id, importBatchPick?.id]` in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shipments.tsx line 484. RESULT: FIX CONFIRMED WORKING. Steps executed via Playwright at 390×844 mobile viewport, logged in as admin@test.com: (1) Navigated directly to /(tabs)/shipments?payment_batch_id=66dd423a-a1a8-43b7-bc23-245e2ffca6b5&payment_batch_label=CHQ%20No.000747. Network trace shows exactly ONE GET https://logistics-hub-740.preview.emergentagent.com/api/shipments?payment_batch_id=66dd423a-a1a8-43b7-bc23-245e2ffca6b5 fired (batch id present in query string). The 'All' tab counter reads 28 — matches batch.total_articles from GET /api/payment-batches. The visible list is narrowed to the 28 shipments in the batch. (2) Regression check — tapped the red-X filter-icon (testID='filter-icon', which flips to `handleClearAllFilters` when any filter is active). Two follow-up GET /api/shipments requests fire WITHOUT `payment_batch_id`, the 'All' tab counter jumps back to 500, and Pending/Processing counters repopulate. No stale filtered request leaked. Both directions of the toggle work — the stale-closure bug is resolved. Note: the optional UX improvement from iteration 50 (rendering a visible batch-filter chip in the header with the label + ✕) is still NOT implemented — user only sees the small red dot on the funnel icon; the batch label 'CHQ No.000747' is not surfaced anywhere on the shipments header. Flagged as design_issue but not a Fix #2 blocker.

action_items: (Optional / carried over from iteration 50) Render a visible batch-filter chip in the shipments header when paymentBatchPick/importBatchPick is active — show label + ✕ so the operator sees which batch is currently narrowing the list.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct — extending the deps to `[search, paymentBatchPick?.id, importBatchPick?.id]` at shipments.tsx:484 rebuilds the closure whenever a pick is set/cleared. useFocusEffect (line 498-502) also re-runs because `load` is listed in its deps.
shipments.tsx is still 4302 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting once the current bug queue is drained.

handleClearAllFilters (line 275) calls `load()` synchronously right after `setPaymentBatchPick(null)`. Because setState is batched, the synchronous `load()` fires with the still-stale closure — but React re-renders immediately, `load` is re-memoized, and useFocusEffect's dep change on `load` triggers a second unfiltered call. The observed 2 GET /api/shipments requests after clear are this double-fire. Not a bug (both are unfiltered, final state is correct) but the double request is wasted. Consider dropping the explicit `load()` call in handleClearAllFilters and rely solely on the useFocusEffect re-run driven by the new `load` identity.

rca_of_issue: Verification: With fix at shipments.tsx:484 deps=`[search, paymentBatchPick?.id, importBatchPick?.id]`, the deep-link useEffect at line 540 calls setPaymentBatchPick which invalidates the memoized `load`; useFocusEffect (deps=[load,...]) picks up the new identity on the same render pass and fires GET /api/shipments with `payment_batch_id`. Observed network: single request with `payment_batch_id=66dd423a-a1a8-43b7-bc23-245e2ffca6b5`, All tab=28 (matches batch.total_articles). Reset path (tap red-X filter-icon → handleClearAllFilters at line 256) clears paymentBatchPick, load is re-memoized without the batch id, useFocusEffect refires with unfiltered query → All tab returns to 500. Both directions confirmed.
